messages:
anya: Heads-up: embargoed announce for Thu. Need final changelog link, canonical CTA for webinar, and an inbound lead routing plan. Who's got the checklist?

sophie: I'm on changelog. Will push final PR by EOD. Question: do we call out quantized fallback in the headline or only in the deep-dive?

eli: Headline should be benefits-first. Save technical fallback for the docs + changelog anchor. Marketing CTA: 'Join our launch webinar' with /register link.

lina: For inbound leads, Sales Ops asked for a landing form param ?src=announce and prefer us to POST leads to https://hooks.sales.redwood.ai/announce. Can engineering confirm auth header will be active?

ops-bot: NOTE: Scheduled deploy window: canary 2026-03-26T09:50:00-07:00 full 2026-03-26T10:00:00-07:00. Watch ops-channel.

marco: (ops) Confirmed: sales hook will accept HMAC X-Sales-Signature header. I'll coordinate secret rotation with sales-ops now.

anya: Great. Sophie, please include the exact anchor URL in the changelog so we can link to "rollout fallbacks" from the marketing post. Also we need a small benchmark graphic (prod CDN) and alt text.

sophie: Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/428 — anchor will be /release/2026-03-26#rollout-fallbacks. Snippet: "fallback to quantized-v2 under heavy memory pressure; improved batching for short contexts."

eli: For webinar CTA, short subject lines to A/B test in email: 1) "See how we cut inference cost by 30%" 2) "Live demo: Faster inference at scale" — which do we prefer?

anya: Let's run both. A on 50%, B on 50% for the email send. Track clicks by UTM: utm_campaign=announce-2026-03-26 utm_variant=A/B.

lina: Routing rules for leads: if company_size > 500 => sales-enterprise, else => lead-nurture. Sales wants first-touch email within 1 hour. I'll handoff the mapping table to eng.

marco: I'll expose a small mapping endpoint on the announce webhook that returns routing metadata. Will be live by T-2h. URL: https://api.redwood.ai/internal/announce-routing

ops-bot: Healthcheck at T-30m: /v1/announce/health 200 OK, latency 42ms.

sophie: CDN image uploaded to prod: https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/launch/bench-26mar-compact.png (alt: "March 2026: latency & cost per 1k tokens"). Use the compact image for the tweet thread.

anya: Social one-liner: "Launch: faster, cheaper inference — new batching & graceful fallbacks. Join our webinar to see the demo." Keep it punchy.

eli: Email body preview (for devs):
```
We've tuned adaptive batching and added safer fallbacks to keep your app online during pressure spikes. Join our live demo Thu 10:00 PT. Register: https://redwood.ai/register?utm_campaign=announce-2026-03-26&utm_variant=A
```

lina: Sales webhook auth test request: POST sent with X-Sales-Signature header at T-1h. Marco, can you confirm logs show the handshake?

marco: Confirmed in ops logs: handshake OK, signature verified, routing endpoint returning JSON with route:sales-enterprise for test payload.

anya: Final checklist for publish: changelog live, docs anchor live, CDN images accessible, sales webhook auth validated, announce healthcheck 200, email variants queued. Any blockers?

sophie: No blockers from docs. Changelog merged.

eli: Email queueing done. A/B set.

lina: Lead routing test passed.

marco: Ops will monitor for 15m after announce. Rollback policy set: revert to previous canary if 5xx rate > 1% over 2m.

anya: Excellent. Locking announce at 09:55 PT (announce post), webinar email at 10:00 PT. I'll post the final copy in #marketing-announce at T-10m.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled by marco: 6141592800 (canary), 6141592900 (full).

anya: :thumbsup: thanks team. We'll capture performance metrics and lead counts in the postmortem doc.

eli: :thumbsup:

lina: :thumbsup:

marco: :thumbsup: monitoring enabled.
